summary: Created lib/git.js (Node-stdlib only, execFileSync arg-arrays, never shell strings): isRepo, initRepo (idempotent: init+local identity fallback+.gitignore+empty initial commit, returns {initialized,head}), createWorktree (branch orch/attempt/<slug>, worktree under BASE/worktrees/<sha1(ws).slice0,16>/<slug>, idempotent), removeWorktree (force remove+prune+branch -D, idempotent), listWorktrees (porcelain parse). Reuses overlay.js sha1/BASE conventions. Every fn handles not-a-repo gracefully. Added test/git.test.js (plain Node, smoke.sh style). Result: `node test/git.test.js` -> "20 passed, 0 failed", EXIT=0 (stderr fatal:/error: lines are the intentional not-a-repo + idempotency probes, all swallowed). FOUNDATION SCOPE ONLY: no merge/judge logic.
